text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've been really locked in as of late, my
schedule
packed to the brim with
training sessions and
races. But one day,
I get an unexpected call...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Brrring! Brrring!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Trainer! Would you happen to be
free
tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I'd love to go on a picnic together!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... The breeze feels great. Just
perfect
weather for a picnic!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Don't mention it! I'm glad we can spend
some
time together like this! Besides...

Oh? Excuse me, but is that you, Light
Hello?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...It couldn't be!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
This is my former trainer!
Wow, long time
no see!

text_block_list.name: Former Trainer
text_block_list.text:
So you're working as an event producer
now? I
read about your undertakings in a
magazine.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I've got a lot to learn, but I'm doing
my best!

text_block_list.name: Former Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I see you're still just as much of a hard
worker as
back in the day.

text_block_list.name: Former Trainer
text_block_list.text:
You'd always tackle my training regimen
head on.
Even when your race results
were lacking, you
never threw in the
towel.

text_block_list.name: Former Trainer
text_block_list.text:
But I let all that effort go to waste. I
wasn't able
to lead you to the stage
where you could truly
shine. And yet,
you—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate everything you did for me.
My
academy life was very fulfilling, and
every day
was a lot of fun!

text_block_list.name: Former Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I saw that smile, I'd wonder to
myself
whether I could have done more
for you. I wish
things could have ended
differently...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Wait... I want to tell you something.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I really am grateful. Those days are what
made me
who I am today.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I want to build a stage upon which other

Umamusume can shine. The experiences
I had at
the academy form the bedrock
of that dream.

text_block_list.name: Former Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad to hear that, Light Hello. Make
sure you
see that dream of yours
through. And know that
I'll always be
cheering you on.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I never realized how deeply I was cared
for. I
should've depended on my trainer
more.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Relying on someone isn't just about
following
instructions. I've finally come
to understand that
after meeting you.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
You're someone who'll take me out for a
break,
and someone I can share
embarrassing moments
with.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
You taught me that it's important to let
others
dote on you now and then.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
And that's exactly why I invited you out
to this
picnic!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Haven't you felt exhausted lately?
Getting
through so many intense races
must be taking its
toll.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
There's no better time for a break than
right now!
Don't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
So first up, let's rejuvenate that weary
body of
yours with a massage!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
All right, now that those stiff shoulders
are
loosened up, it's time to fill up your
belly and soul
with some good food! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Light Hello continues to help me
recharge for
quite some time...
Trai...ner...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. ♪ Good morning. Someone slept
like a log.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing to apologize for. I'm
glad you felt
relaxed enough to fall
asleep.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Let me know the next time you feel
fatigued,
okay? I'd be happy to do this
again.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to start depending on the
kindness of
others a lot more, too!
